desc:
Product recommendations in emails make your messages feel more relevant by adding suggested items to the mail you already send. Ecom Swift LLC builds the blocks in your email tool, matches your design and tests them on real sample profiles.

## Why emails need product suggestions

Most store emails send everyone the same thing. A shopper who just bought a coffee grinder gets a banner for a sofa, and a shopper who browsed running shoes hears nothing about running shoes. Each message becomes easy to skip.

A recommendation block fixes the mismatch. It fills part of the email with items chosen for that person, such as what goes with their last order or what they viewed but did not buy. The email still carries your voice and offer, but the products feel chosen rather than scattered.

## What are product recommendation blocks in email?

Product recommendation blocks in email are sections that pull items from your store catalog into a message, based on rules or customer data. Your email tool fills the block when the email is sent or opened, so two readers can see different products in the same template. Most email tools for online stores include some form of dynamic product block.

## How suggestions change email results

Relevant products give a reader a reason to click that a generic banner does not. A post purchase email can suggest a matching item while the first order is still on their mind. A browse follow up can remind a shopper of what they looked at and add similar choices.

The effect depends on your list, your products and the timing of each flow, so we set up click reporting by block where the package allows it. That lets you compare flows and see which blocks bring visits and orders instead of guessing.

## What a good email recommendation setup includes

- A product block designed to match your existing email style.
- Placement in the flows that matter most, such as post purchase and browse follow up.
- A newsletter block for regular campaigns.
- A fallback to best sellers when a customer has no history.
- Items the customer already bought left out of the list.
- Out of stock products skipped.
- Previews on phone and desktop, in light and dark mode where possible.
- Tests with sample customer profiles, so you see different versions.
- Clear images, prices and one button per product.
- A click view by block, so you can compare placements.

## What we do

We start by reviewing your email tool, your current flows and your brand style. We choose the flows to improve and decide what each block should show. For a post purchase email, that might be items that pair with the order. For a browse follow up, it might be viewed items plus similar ones.

We then build each block, apply your fonts and colors and set the fallback rules. Before anything goes live, we send test emails using sample profiles: a new customer, a repeat buyer and a visitor with only browsing history. You see exactly what each person receives.

Basic adds one block to one email. Standard covers three flows or templates and adds the profile tests. Premium covers more flows, adds a newsletter block, excludes bought items and includes a click report and subject line ideas to test. We do not promise results, and we never send campaigns without your approval.

## Do and avoid

**Do:**
- Keep the block short, with a few clear products.
- Use a fallback so no email shows an empty space.
- Send a test to yourself on a phone before launch.
- Respect the consent choices your subscribers made.
- Compare blocks by clicks, not by looks alone.

**Avoid:**
- Filling the email with a long grid of items.
- Suggesting products the reader just bought.
- Using tiny images or unreadable prices.
- Adding blocks to flows that are about delivery or account security.
- Changing the template without a test send.

## Who this is for

This service suits stores that already run welcome, post purchase or abandoned browse flows and want them to work harder. It also suits owners who send a weekly newsletter with one fixed set of products. If your list is small, we keep the setup light and focus on the most useful flow first.

## What we need from you

Tell us which email tool you use and which flows you want to improve. Give us collaborator or team access to the tool and your store, never your password. Send your brand colors and a sample email you like. We confirm the plan before we edit any live flow.
